correctness.rationale: Signed-sum feasibility is equivalent to the generator-based rainbow geodesic property. Positive cases provide explicit two-colorings and cover every missing cyclic distance. Negative cases use forced colors at maximal sums, and for ell=3k use a descending induction plus a wrap congruence exception handled by k>=3; ell=3k+1 has an unavoidable same-generator distance. Every claimed graph has diameter two by covering consecutive distance intervals. The packaged independent finite oracle exhausts 862 parameter triples, including explicit full-graph checks for every positive one. Infinite correctness rests on the written proof.

Both explicit positive constructions and infinite negative obstruction bands yield reusable methods beyond a finite special case. The results do not pretend to settle high-degree or unrestricted conjectures.
